name: path-rehearsal
description: A deterministic live rehearsal of the goal paths no research run has reached: a flat world laid out by console commands, six real bodies, and the scripted path exerciser. Not a research run and never published.
layout: Six groups far enough apart that only beta hears zeta's speech (24 blocks): alpha beside a three-log trunk; beta three blocks from one log on a pillar whose top is a three-by-three ring of bottom slabs, half a block below the log and in sight under its line to it, so its drop rests on that ring wherever its random throw takes it, outside the pickup box and with no route up, and is left lying, with zeta four blocks off; gamma four blocks from delta, who stands on a stick vanilla may not pick up for 450 ticks; epsilon beside one log and a log item no one may pick up that despawns about 500 ticks after it is summoned, with another log 25.5 blocks east, past what even a goal review's sense looks for, which a walk to the edge of sight east reveals out of dig reach and the walk beside it reaches; theta stands on a stick vanilla may not pick up for 1100 ticks, on a stone pad that gives a bare hand nothing, so its met goal is completed plainly and owes a review; eta stands on grass beside a pocket under an overhang, the block east of its support with stone two above it, with a three-log trunk 3.2 blocks off, so its log goal is restated and completed beside a log; gamma, once clear of delta, is refused a dirt goal beside the frontier; iota stands at 43.357 in a one-cell pit, its only standable cell, beside a one-high nook east whose log lies at 44.863, 0.08 past vanilla's pickup box from where iota stands, as r28 rehearsal alpha's did at tick 9765; kappa stands with its box against the north face of the 128-block world border at z -64, 3.2 blocks north of a creeper that cannot move, so its flight must run along the border rather than over it, as v29 rehearsal theta's flights from a skeleton did not; kappa's tree line runs along z -40 from x -60 to -20, more than the 16 blocks a goal review senses from the border and from epsilon, so neither sees it before it walks; on an easy world that keeps hostile mobs but spawns none (the doMobSpawning gamerule is off); Bukkit's monster spawn limit is zero from the first tick, because superflat ground lies below y 40, where slimes spawn in any light.
